title: Tuberculosis treatment has advanced — now we need to stop drug resistance dragging us backwards
title_zh: 结核病治疗已取得进展——现在我们需要阻止耐药性拖累我们的发展
abstract: The next major advancement in TB might not be a new drug, but a better understanding of how and why resistance to medicines emerges.
abstract_zh: 结核病的下一大突破可能不是新药，而是更深入地理解药物耐药性如何产生及其原因。
snippet: The next major advancement in TB might not be a new drug, but a better understanding of how and why resistance to medicines emerges.
